meta.title: Lba Rda And Council Formal Meeting

votes.motion: Close the public hearing on the LBA Budget for Fiscal Year 2021-22 and refer the item to a future date for action
votes.description: The Local Building Authority board closed the public hearing on the LBA Capital Projects Fund budget for FY2021-22, which covers bond debt services for the Glendale and Marmalade Libraries, and deferred action to a future meeting.

votes.motion: Adjourn as the Local Building Authority and reconvene as the Redevelopment Agency
votes.description: The LBA board voted to end the Local Building Authority meeting and transition to the Redevelopment Agency meeting.

votes.motion: Close the public hearing on the RDA Budget for Fiscal Year 2021-22 and refer the item to a future date for action
votes.description: The Redevelopment Agency board closed the public hearing on the RDA's final budget for FY2021-22 and deferred action to a future meeting.

votes.motion: Adjourn as the Redevelopment Agency and reconvene as the City Council
votes.description: The RDA board voted to end the Redevelopment Agency meeting and transition to the City Council meeting.

votes.motion: Approve the Work Session meeting minutes for Tuesday, September 29, 2020
votes.description: The City Council approved the official work session meeting minutes from September 29, 2020.

votes.motion: Adopt joint ceremonial Resolution 19 of 2021, celebrating Pride Month
votes.description: The City Council adopted a joint ceremonial resolution with Mayor Mendenhall recognizing and celebrating Pride Month.

votes.motion: Close the public hearing on Budget Amendment No. 9 for Fiscal Year 2020-21 and refer the item to a future date for action
votes.description: The Council closed the public hearing on the FY2020-21 Budget Amendment No. 9 and deferred final action to a later meeting.

votes.motion: Close the public hearing on FY2021-22 budget-related ordinances (Items G2-G13) and refer the items to a future date for action
votes.description: The Council closed the public hearing covering multiple FY2021-22 budget ordinances including labor MOUs, compensation plans, tax levy, library fund budget, fee schedules, and the main city budget, deferring action to a future meeting.

votes.motion: Adopt Ordinance 21 of 2021, vacating the subject alley adjacent to 1025 West North Temple and 1022, 1028, 1030, and 1032 West Learned Avenue
votes.description: The Council approved vacating a 180-foot City-owned alley to allow the applicant to consolidate adjacent lots and construct a multi-family residential structure.

votes.motion: Adopt Ordinance 22 of 2021, vacating the Fern Subdivision Alley located between 1000 East and 1100 East and between Wood Avenue and Logan Avenue
votes.description: The Council approved vacating the Fern Subdivision Alley, an east-west alley running behind eight homes, as petitioned under PLNPCM2018-0046.

votes.motion: Adopt Resolution 21 of 2021 authorizing up to $1 billion in airport revenue bonds to finance capital improvements to the Salt Lake City International Airport
votes.description: The Council authorized the issuance of up to $1 billion in limited obligation airport revenue bonds to continue financing construction of the new Salt Lake City International Airport, with repayment solely from airport-generated revenue, and set a public hearing for July 13, 2021.

votes.motion: Meet remotely without an anchor location and ratify the Chair's determination under State Law
votes.description: The Council ratified the Chair's determination to continue holding meetings remotely and without an anchor location due to health and safety concerns and the closure of the City and County Building to the public.

votes.motion: Adopt Ordinance 23 of 2021, amending the FY21 Annual Compensation Plan Appendix B for appointed employees
votes.description: The Council approved an ordinance amending Appendix B of the FY2020-21 Annual Compensation Plan for Non-Represented Employees to formally recognize the existing Deputy Chief of Staff position in the Mayor's Office.

votes.motion: Adopt Resolution 20 of 2021, authorizing an Interlocal Agreement between Salt Lake City and Salt Lake County for reimbursement of up to $55,365 for reconfiguration of the Gilmer Drive intersection
votes.description: The Council approved an interlocal cooperation agreement under which Salt Lake County will reimburse the City up to $55,365 for reconfiguring the 900 South and Gilmer Drive intersection and related improvements.

votes.motion: Adopt the Consent Agenda except for Item L3 – the appointment of Justin Rodriguez
votes.description: The Council approved the consent agenda items including setting a public hearing date for airport bonds, appointing Joshua Isbell to the Police Civilian Review Board, and reappointing Dave Mortensen and Katherine Potter to the Arts Council, while excluding the Justin Rodriguez PCRB appointment.
